stations.title: Kwabena
stations.say: Why is Bronwen's note by Esme?

stations.title: Pick-up
stations.say: Is that note for my child?

captions: Next, Kwabena takes Arlo off the register, and the notes move to other children.
Bronwen's note now sits beside Esme, and the waiting list's ticks move when it is sorted.
You give every row a key of its own, in the class and the waiting list, in three tasks.
Arlo leaves, and Bronwen's note stays beside Bronwen.
Same register, same notes. Each child keeps what was typed for them.
